Today, there is an update on the November cyclone for the Chennai–Puducherry coast.

## November cyclone for the Chennai–Puducherry coast
The India Meteorological Department, or IMD, has issued a heavy rainfall alert for Tamil Nadu and Puducherry for the next few days. This warning comes as the region is being watched for potential cyclonic activity in November. Residents in these areas should prepare for significant precipitation.
